description: A vehicle USD on 4 ANCF FEM tires driven by hand over a newton-terrain-tool boulder field (--terrain field_01_boulders | field_02_hills_boulders). run-examples.sh asks which vehicle USD to load (default: the Sherp; see 03_vehicle_ancf_tires). Rigid parts collide with the fine 0.25 m grid (vendored mujoco_warp: 128 hfield prisms per geom). The terrain relief changes live from the UI: stage w (heights = w * I_N) slider / buttons rescale the ANCF contact grid, the MuJoCo collider and the rendered mesh, then the vehicle is re-dropped onto the rocks (lift = highest rock under the tire footprints and hull). Driving = the base example's steer / throttle sliders + CTIS panel, or the arrow keys (UP/DOWN throttle, LEFT/RIGHT steer, SPACE stop). 'Reset vehicle' restores the at-rest snapshot at the origin. Start at stage 0.4. kn / kd / pcg-iters null = tire asset recommendation.
